customManagers.description: ghcr.io/workos/emulate is pinned inside a run: script in ci.yml, so the github-actions manager can't see it

packageRules.description: A workos/emulate bump can be a breaking iss-claim change (see issue #295) - must be reviewed, never automerged. groupName forces the ci.yml (customManagers) and docker-compose.floci.yml (built-in docker-compose manager) updates onto one branch/PR so the pins can't drift apart.
